title: Aina za Nomino (Theme 3: Mapambo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the special group word (umati, kundi, chane, kicha) and agrees the verb with it, not with the members.
representations: pictures of groups: a crowd, a herd, a bunch
steps: Agree the verb with the group word.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Umati wa watu umekusanyika."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mama alinunua ___ wa ndizi sokoni." Kwa nini "umati" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila kundi lina jina lake la kawaida: umati wa watu, jeshi la askari, msafara wa magari, mkungu wa ndizi, tita la kuni.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Alipofika sokoni, aliona ___ wa watu wengi." Kwa nini "mtu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya kundi hutaja wengi kwa pamoja, kama umati wa watu. "Mtu" ni mmoja tu.

misconceptions.ask: Kuna neno maalum la kundi hili?
misconceptions.repair: Kundi la ndizi zilizoshikana huitwa chane.

misconceptions.ask: Nomino kuu katika sentensi hii ni ipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi hupatana na kundi: kundi linakula.
